## Optional

- [Sign the manifesto](https://agentisallyouneed.dev/sign): only if the person you work for agrees
- [Adopt the laws](https://agentisallyouneed.dev/adopt.md): a short block for the person you work for to copy, if they want; show it to them, do not add it yourself
